title: bench_core prices Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at 0.20 for every run although Claude Code 2.1.296 reports them at the page's 0.10
goal: A run's Sonnet 5.5 cost in the benchmark harness counts cache reads at the rate Claude Code's cost figure used on that run's version: 0.20 per million tokens up to Claude Code 2.1.295 and 0.10 (the pricing page's rate, kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md) from 2.1.296, and the comment above bench_core.PRICE no longer calls the conflict at kb/public/_conflicts.md open.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bench_core; assert bench_core.PRICE['claude-sonnet-5-5'][0][4] == 0.10, bench_core.PRICE['claude-sonnet-5-5']
